# Appendix: the architectural constants

[← dictionary index](index.md)

The numbers of the processor status word, the modes, the exception vectors, the page-table entry, the memory types, the translation geometry, the system registers, the addressing modes and the condition codes, each read from the machine-readable specification (`spec/pdp64-system.hbnf` and `spec/pdp64-mnemonics.hbnf`).

*Generated by `tools/mkmanual.py`; do not edit.*

## The processor status word (16 bits)

| Field | Bit | Width | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `C` | 0 | 1 | carry (borrow after a subtract) |
| `V` | 1 | 1 | signed overflow |
| `Z` | 2 | 1 | zero |
| `N` | 3 | 1 | negative |
| `T` | 4 | 1 | trace: take a trace trap after the next instruction |
| `PRI` | 5 | 3 | interrupt priority level, 0 to 7 |
| `MODE` | 8 | 2 | current mode |
| `PREV` | 10 | 2 | previous mode (the mode before the last exception) |

Bits 12 to 15 are reserved and read as zero. Bit 12 is the user-memory guard `UA`.

## The modes

| Mode | Value |
|---|---|
| kernel | 0 |
| supervisor | 1 |
| user | 3 |

Value 2 is reserved: loading it into either mode field of the status word is an illegal instruction.

## The exception vectors

The table has 512 entries of eight bytes at the physical address `VBR + 8 * vector`; `ECAUSE` equals the vector number.

| Vector | Number | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| `RESET` | 0 | processor reset: the first instruction fetch |
| `ILLEGAL` | 2 | a reserved or undefined opcode, a reserved encoding or an unassigned system register |
| `PRIVILEGED` | 3 | a system instruction executed outside kernel mode |
| `MISALIGNED` | 4 | a data access whose address is not a multiple of its size (the `MOVU` forms excepted) |
| `NONCANONICAL` | 5 | a virtual address whose bits 63 to 39 differ from bit 38 |
| `IFAULT` | 6 | instruction fetch from a page that is not mapped |
| `LFAULT` | 7 | load from a page that is not mapped |
| `SFAULT` | 8 | store to a page that is not mapped |
| `IPROT` | 9 | instruction fetch denied by the page permissions |
| `LPROT` | 10 | load denied by the page permissions |
| `SPROT` | 11 | store denied by the page permissions |
| `DIVZERO` | 12 | division by zero (`DIV`, `DIVU`, `MOD`, `MODU`) |
| `BUSFAULT` | 13 | a read of non-existent memory (a precise abort) |
| `LPAD` | 14 | an indirect transfer that did not land on `LPAD` (enforcement off in ABI version 1) |
| `BPT` | 15 | the `BPT` instruction |
| `TIMER` | 32 | the timer interrupt (level 6) |
| `COUNT` | 512 | the number of vectors; the table has this many eight-byte entries |

## The page-table entry (64 bits)

| Field | Bit | Width | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `V` | 0 | 1 | valid |
| `R` | 1 | 1 | readable |
| `W` | 2 | 1 | writable |
| `X` | 3 | 1 | executable |
| `U` | 4 | 1 | accessible from user mode |
| `G` | 5 | 1 | global: ignores the ASID |
| `A` | 6 | 1 | accessed (managed by software) |
| `D` | 7 | 1 | dirty (managed by software) |
| `MT` | 8 | 2 | memory type |
| `PPN` | 12 | 28 | physical page number: physical address bits 12 to 39, in place |

A non-leaf entry has `V` = 1 and `R` = `W` = `X` = 0 and points to the next table. Every bit not named is zero.

| cached | 0 |

## The system registers (`MFSR`, `MTSR`)

| Name | Number | Access |
|---|---|---|
| `PTBR` | 0 | read and write |
| `EPC` | 1 | read and write |
| `EVA` | 2 | read only |
| `ECAUSE` | 3 | read only |
| `DMW0` | 4 | read and write |
| `DMW1` | 5 | read and write |
| `USP` | 6 | read and write |
| `SSP` | 7 | read and write |
| `EPSW` | 8 | read and write |
| `VBR` | 9 | read and write |
| `MMUCTL` | 10 | read and write |
| `ASID` | 11 | read and write |
| `CPUID` | 12 | read only |

## The addressing modes

| Mode | Value |
|---|---|
| base | `0000` |
| index | `0001` |
| pcrel | `0010` |
| dp | `0011` |
| imm | `0100` |
| abs | `0101` |
| postinc | `0110` |
| predec | `0111` |

Modes `1000` to `1111` are reserved. The syntax and the parcel layout of each mode are in section 9.5.
